newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Thai Copper postpones listing until 1997 - official.
newsitem.headline: Thai Copper postpones listing until 1997 - official.

text.p: The chairman and chief executive officer of Thai Copper Industries said on Wednesday the public listing of the company has been reset for 1997 because of the slump in the Bangkok stock exchange.

"We plan to list our company sometime next year," Prayudh Mahagitsiri of Thai Copper Industries told reporters in Singapore after signing a technology agreement for the firm's copper smelter with Chilean mining giant Codelco.
Asked why the listing, originally set for this year, was postponed, he cited the slump in the Stock Exchange of Thailand (SET).
"The index came down from 1,450 points to only 900," Prayudh said. "We have no time to think about the listing."
The SET index closed on Tuesday at 919.01 points and was trading by midday on Wednesday at 931.48 points.
